title: Bought 15 lb got 20 lb - stickers over the actual weight on box
text: Bought 15 lb got 20 lb - stickers over the actual weight on box. This seems like a real quality blanket, BUT it was purchased for my 100 lb 12 yr old as a Hannukah gift and I wanted the lightest I could get in a 60" x 80", which was a 15lb blanket.  My husband weighed it, after my son opened his gift and told me that it was 20 lbs, NOT 15 lbs.  I checked the box that the blanket came in and there were stickers over the weight on the box, so I peeled one off (in the picture with this review).  I am guessing the 20 lbs don't sell that well, since the weighted blankets are meant to be for 10% of the person's body weight, so they decided to lie about the weight and stick the 15 lb stickers on them and send them out, hoping no one would notice.
